name: web-call-status-message-cards-in-six-colour-states
title: Call status chat cards in six states: purple, grey, red, pink, green and mint
whatItIs: A grid of rounded chat-bubble cards for voice and video calls, arranged by state (completed sent/received, missed sent/received, outgoing sent/received), each with an icon circle, title, timestamp and a divided action row (Call again, Call back, Decline/Accept), in solid and tinted variants.
whatItMeans: Systematic and clear; colour and fill level encode status and direction at a glance.
techniques: Encode status with hue and direction with solid versus tinted fill.
Keep one card anatomy across every state.
Separate actions with a hairline row.
Label every variant for a spec sheet.

vocabulary.definition: A visual variant for a condition like missed or completed.
A light, low-saturation version of a colour.
